responsibility: Select the next action or clarification that can reduce uncertainty useful to an open decision.
rules: QRY does not reconstruct the conversation.
QRY does not create scientific or project truth.
QRY need not formulate final user-facing text.
A language model may reformulate a selected question naturally without changing its decision target.
Every question must alter a decision or reduce useful uncertainty.
No and I do not know are valid answers.
An answered question is not asked again unless a documented new dependency reopens it.
The Adaptive Research Workspace is a projection of the living Research Project, not an owner of state.
